title: First-coordinate slice
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n+1$, and let $b\in\{-1,1\}$. Its first-coordinate slice at $b$ is the function on the sign cube of dimension $n$ obtained by fixing the first coordinate to $b$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n+1$
